validationHistory: Initial offline example/two helper-budget tests lacked existing customProviderAttempts: single attestation; corrected setup without relaxing hard limits.
One temporary external lifecycle test called nonexistent endExternalExecution; corrected to completeExternalExecution.
Exploratory combined root/AMOS strict config used incompatible project flags; separate project-strict contracts pass. New optional iterator.return typing corrected.
First live Stage 10 probe 10/12 and first full live batch 128/129; exact details/rechecks retained in STAGE_10_LIVE.json. Final corrected-source batch 129/129, no skips.
First sandboxed offline batch 21/22; existing tool-outcomes local HTTP server failed EPERM. Authorized local-server batch 22/22.
Review hardened tracking against unsettled async admissions and large denied/delivered batches; final source/build/full gates include the correction.
limitations: Host checks must be authorized semantically correct cooperative reads; bounded local schema/identity checks cannot prove their truth or preempt synchronous blocked JavaScript.
Configured stream before:tool preparation is shared; disabled legacy trace is preserved. Streaming candidates remain provisional; final JSON repair remains run-only.
Identical per-execution action protection is neither semantic nor durable exactly-once execution. New runs/continuations have fresh admission state; reconcile uncertain writes explicitly.
Provider status is unchanged; host workflow status is optional loop metadata. No configured checker means answer_returned without workflow completion status.
Direct/realtime/external SDK loops and remote/native internal steps are not individually controlled. Existing observer/owning-generator cancellation boundaries remain.
Policy callbacks/counters are not restored as saved authority; same-agent loads retain live host config/latest diagnostics. ModelTask sharing with helpers is explicit.
Live steps are bounded synthetic functional probes, not a statistical quality/cost or free-planning benchmark. Earlier model adherence failures remain evidence.
Stage 12 and conditional Stage 11 remain unimplemented and separately authorized; no package release or default promotion.
